_note: Assembled from product/recent-deals/inputs/ (team files finalized 2026-10-26). Every graded input is dated on or before announced_on.

replacement_cost.missing: Only a $20M to $25M price range was public at announcement (Sep 17, 2026), so price per key isn't graded.

spread.missing: No trailing-12-month cap rate or NOI disclosed at announcement.

supply.missing: Choose Chicago lists the downtown pipeline (Aug 2026) but states no share of existing rooms; no single public source gave the total pipeline share by Sep 17, 2026.

demand.period: City of Chicago hotel tax revenue, calendar 2025 vs 2024, the latest full year published; $161.1M vs $156.6M (printed +$4.5M)

debt_context.summary: Arm's-length REIT sale of a non-core hotel under PK's stated divestiture program; no loan event, special servicing or receivership reported for this hotel, and no buyer-seller relationship stated by Sep 17, 2026.

v1.1._note: v1.1: supply graded on Choose Chicago's CBD area (downtown hotel). Price per key graded on the first confirmed price ($25M, Oct 25, 2026), dated to that confirmation. Other factors as v1.
